name: THE PLOT SICKENS
notes: $2000 Eyam cloth-parcel origin is the traditional account, not documented fact — rewrote to open 'By tradition'; other four verified.

name: BEDSIDE MANORS
notes: Galen through Pare all accurate; rows 1-2 sit close in difficulty but the climb holds.

name: MOLE PATROL
notes: Mata Hari to the Culper Ring; Philby's 1963 Beirut flight and Hall's 'limping lady' nickname both check out.

name: ENCRYPT KEEPER
notes: $400 said Marines 'simply' radioed in Navajo — the talkers used a coded vocabulary, so rewrote as 'a battlefield code built on this people's unwritten language'.

name: THE REGINA MONOLOGUES
notes: Isabella to Margaret I all verified; five different continents' worth of queens keeps responses varied.

name: THE REGENT ERA
notes: Regents verified; 'Jahangir' shares a syllable with Nur Jahan but naming her husband is the fair handle at $2000.

name: SMALL THINGS CONSIDERED
notes: Verified Priestley's naming of rubber, Hunt's $15-debt safety pin and Goldman's hired shills; Franklin is properly hedged with 'credited'.

name: SECOND-HAND HISTORY
notes: Wristwatch to Harrison is a genuine staircase; clepsydra etymology and the Day of Two Noons both correct.

name: MILESTONE AGE
notes: Appian Way to McAdam all accurate, including the chasqui relay and the tarmac etymology.

name: CARGO CULTURE
notes: Timbuktu to nutmeg; the Breda clue states what each side kept rather than the sloppy 'swap' version.

name: RABBLE WITHOUT A CAUSE
notes: $2000 mis-dated the Rebecca Riots as 1840s and stated the biblical naming as fact — now 'riots of 1839-43' with 'usually traced to'.

name: SAILS PITCH
notes: Lind, Bounty, grog, impressment, Plimsoll line all verified; Vernon's 'Old Grog' nickname correctly explained.
